blocks.raw: # Official documents
blocks.text: Official documents

blocks.raw: US regulators require all investors to receive certain documents pertaining to their Accounts. The documents must be made available to clients through your application. DriveWealth allows registered counter-parties to brand these documents with their logo and contact details.
blocks.text: US regulators require all investors to receive certain documents pertaining to their Accounts. The documents must be made available to clients through your application. DriveWealth allows registered counter-parties to brand these documents with their logo and contact details.

blocks.raw:
> 🚧 UAT statement generation

blocks.raw: ## Trade confirmations
blocks.text: Trade confirmations

blocks.raw: A Trade Confirmation is a required notification of a securities transaction. These are made available T+1. The customer must have access to this document prior to the completion of the settlement cycle (T+2).

blocks.raw: ## Month-end account statements
blocks.text: Month-end account statements

blocks.raw: The month-end account statement details a user's activity during a month and is uploaded to the user's accounts on the first weekend of every month; no later than the 10th of the month. Account Statements are typically available the first weekend, monthly.

blocks.raw: ## Retrieving documents
blocks.text: Retrieving documents

blocks.raw: Fetching a list of documents available can be done via 3 APIs:
blocks.text: Fetching a list of documents available can be done via 3 APIs:

blocks.raw:
* [List Statements](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/get_accounts-accountid-statements)
* [List Trade Confirms](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/get_accounts-accountid-confirms)
* [List Tax Documents](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/get_accounts-accountid-taxforms)
blocks.text: List StatementsList Trade ConfirmsList Tax Documents

blocks.raw: You can set the date range in the query params of the GET request to retrieve the statements for a given period of time. See the examples below:
blocks.text: You can set the date range in the query params of the GET request to retrieve the statements for a given period of time. See the examples below:

blocks.raw:
```javascript
GET /back-office/accounts/{accountID}/statements?from=2023-01-01&to=2023-02-01
GET /back-office/accounts/{accountID}/confirms?from=2023-01-01&to=2023-02-01
```
In the above examples, the statements for January and February of 2023 will be returned. The response will contain a `displayName` and `fileKey`.
blocks.text: In the above examples, the statements for January and February of 2023 will be returned. The response will contain a displayName and fileKey.

blocks.raw: Use the fileKey and accountID to fetch the individual statement URL from the [Statements Endpoint](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/get_statements-accountid-filekey). The `url` field links the PDF version of the account statement; this is a temporary URL and will expire after 5 minutes.
blocks.text: Use the fileKey and accountID to fetch the individual statement URL from the Statements Endpoint. The url field links the PDF version of the account statement; this is a temporary URL and will expire after 5 minutes.

blocks.raw: The above methodology works exactly the same for month-end statements, trade confirmations and tax forms.
blocks.text: The above methodology works exactly the same for month-end statements, trade confirmations and tax forms.

blocks.raw: ## Document notifications
blocks.text: Document notifications

blocks.raw: DriveWealth does not send out direct notifications to customers when these official documents are made available.
blocks.text: DriveWealth does not send out direct notifications to customers when these official documents are made available.

blocks.raw: You can take advantage of the [Statement Events API](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/statements-events) in order to receive a notification on your SQS queue when a new document has been made available. That Event can then be consumed and published back out through your platform in any way seen fit.
blocks.text: You can take advantage of the Statement Events API in order to receive a notification on your SQS queue when a new document has been made available. That Event can then be consumed and published back out through your platform in any way seen fit.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Statement links
>
> Generally when sending a notification to a customer that their document has been made available (like over email), the physical document is not included in that notification to protect customer PII. Instead, a link to the reports section within the platform is given for customers to access.

blocks.raw: ## Hosted reports
blocks.text: Hosted reports

blocks.raw: DriveWealth additionally offers a Customer Reporting Portal that can be accessed directly through a DriveWealth hosted webpage. If a user were to close their account with you halfway through the year they could still retrieve their documents in the [Customer Reporting Portal](https://client.drivewealth.com/login).
blocks.text: DriveWealth additionally offers a Customer Reporting Portal that can be accessed directly through a DriveWealth hosted webpage. If a user were to close their account with you halfway through the year they could still retrieve their documents in the Customer Reporting Portal.

blocks.raw: Customers can also update their tax form information through the portal.
